Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up - we're proposing a global PTO accrual harmonization across full-time roles plus adding 6 cultural observance floating days. Draft of handbook section here: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbook/pto-accrual-draft (comments open). Please read and flag anything that affects your teams by EOD Friday.
Sam (People Ops): Action items: 1) Managers confirm team headcounts in this sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Example 2) People Ops will run retroactive accrual calculations if approved 3) Mandatory compliance refresher (45m) tied to policy changes - RSVP by next Tue. :calendar:
Jen (Eng Manager): Reading now. Quick Q - does "harmonization" change accrual for folks in EU with local statutory minima?
Elliot (Legal): Good Q. Harmonization sets a global baseline that is never below local statutory requirements. For EU teams local law remains controlling - we'll include a per-country appendix. Effective date proposed: 2025-06-01 to allow payroll adjustments.
Zach (Hiring Ops): Heads-up: new hires starting before effective date keep current accrual schedule until their 1-year anniversary to avoid proration churn. Is that the plan?
Maya (People Ops): Yes - we'll include a transition rule. Zach, please flag any reqs that need recruiter-facing wording.
Jen (Eng Manager): Ok - can we get a TL;DR for managers to mention in 1:1s? Short bullets would help.
Sam (People Ops): TL;DR for managers (copy/paste): "Starting 2025-06-01 Redwood will apply a single PTO accrual baseline across FT roles; local laws still apply; transitional rules for recent hires; 6 paid cultural observance days added. Mandatory 45m policy+harassment refresher - RSVP by Tue."
Maya (People Ops): Also adding a training tracking column to the sheet. Please mark attendees as they RSVP. We'll use this to block payroll changes if training isn't completed by the cutoff.
hr-bot: Reminder set - RSVP deadline in 5 days. Auto-reminders to managers who haven't confirmed headcounts will run every 48h.
Jen (Eng Manager): Confirmed - I'll update my team headcount now and ping managers on my pod.
Elliot (Legal): Will review the country appendix and post comments in the draft doc by tomorrow morning.
Sam (People Ops): If anyone needs an async message template for their teams I can post one here. Happy to draft. :+1:
Jen (Eng Manager): Please do - that'd be great.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks all. Follow-ups: Sam will post templates, Elliot posts legal appendix, Zach updates hiring ops notes. I'll compile final handbook PR after comments close Friday.
Zach (Hiring Ops): Noted. I'll update the offer templates once PR merges.
hr-bot: Log: thread 1763123456 - policy update workflow started. Tasks assigned: people-ops (owner), legal (review), hiring-ops (offer updates).
